# `chrome-cdp offline`

Take the network away (requests fail, navigator.onLine is false)

```text
chrome-cdp offline [OPTIONS] <on|off>
```

Arguments:

- `<on|off>`: `on` takes the network away, `off` gives it back (one of `on`, `off`)

```text
Examples:
  chrome-cdp offline on
  chrome-cdp offline off
```
